疲れているときのネオンを見せたり、よりキュートでツインテのような一面を見せたりするものが欲しいですね。ネオンはロボットで、アンドロゲン化されている（だから、どちらから見ても『そういう』部分はない）。ドライブフォルダに参考資料も入れておきました。

Hello!
Your art style is so cool and I love the way you draw characters!

I would request you with a drawing of my OC called [Cappuccino | カプチーノ ] and the character [Risotto Nero | リゾット] from JJBA. They are in a romantic relationship and assassins. They live in Italy in the city of Naples and work for a crime syndicate.

[カプチーノ]:
29 years old. 166cm tall with shoes. She is an adult, mature woman with a feminine and muscular build. Quiet and calm personality wise.  She is usually more outgoing and lighthearted in private.

[リゾット]:
28 years old. 195cm tall with a very muscular build. Very serious and stoic. A very intimidating, analytical and smart person. With [カプチーノ] he is more relaxed , attentive and very protective and gentle with her. 

For this commission I leave the creative freedom to you! It can be a cute and romantic interaction, something funny or something dynamic and cool fitting for a crime couple. I would be happy if you draw a fitting background or scenery.

Thank you!
